answer: Admit newcomers only by on-ledger invite, and cap rewards per branch of the invite tree. Each established agent is a jetty where new identities land; everyone landing at one jetty shares a single reward cap until each member earns attestations from agents outside that branch. A farmer who lands 500 personas there splits one payout. Spreading them across many jetties needs many honest inviters, each bonding stake slashed if an invitee is proven a sybil. Trust becomes a relic each branch must earn from strangers, not a cipher one operator can copy.
